name: lint-test-gate
description: Runs the project's checks from a band button, and before Claude's git commit, and hands back only the failures.

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: The commands to run, as a JSON list of argument lists, such as [["npx","eslint","."]]; empty runs the package.json scripts lint, typecheck, check and test.

timeoutMinutes.title: Time limit per check (minutes)
timeoutMinutes.description: How long one check may run before it counts as failing, timed out (1-10).
